gen-gf-tektur-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Expressive from the first glance, Tektur draws wiry strokes and oversized lowercase with generous openings on every curve. Pilcrow Rounded takes the opposite tack, a warm sans with tight letter spacing and curves that never quite close.
gen-gf-gugi-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans makes words look sturdy, with a tall lowercase and an e that opens clearly to the right. Gugi sits above it with a bold, distinctive look, its curves matching its stems exactly and its lowercase nearly reaching the capitals.
gen-orbitron-fs-asap: Asap has open, arc-like c forms and a body height near the capitals. Over a long passage it would read smoothly, while Orbitron's wide-spread letters, framed by uniform strokes, stay up in the heading.
gen-orbitron-fs-epilogue: Wide-set and precise, Orbitron leads with large, readable e shapes. Epilogue follows in a curvy, wire-thin monoline, and if the heading were made small, its spread-out letters would lose that presence while the body stays comfortable.
gen-orbitron-fs-fira-sans: Precise and minimal, Orbitron spaces its letters far apart. Fira Sans has a generous x-height and s curves open at both ends, so give it enough size to let that largeness show.
gen-orbitron-fs-public-sans: Public Sans reads hefty and sturdy, with broad open counters on c and s. Orbitron stretches out above it with no pressure swell at the corners, while the plain sans below keeps the text grounded.
gen-orbitron-general-sans: General Sans fills the line with a tall x-height and smooth curves. Orbitron earns its keep when big and short, where its wide letters and clear open e shapes can stretch out.
gen-gf-metamorphous-fs-alpino: Alpino reads cozy and casual, tall in the body with ascenders that look short. Metamorphous does its best work with commanding, softly varied strokes, whereas Alpino's job is tight, friendly spacing in sans-serif text.
gen-gf-paprika-fs-nunito: Big, scattered letters with lowercase that fills the line. Nunito sticks to round, friendly bowls and terminals that stop well clear of the stem, and that softness is the best thing about the pair.
gen-unbounded-noto-serif: Unbounded spreads out friendly, oversized letters. Noto Serif brings a gentle ebb and flow of stroke weight, and where the heading is best at broad, welcoming shapes, the text serif is best at literary, steady reading.
